'''Aldred Gomaisen''' was a hired mercenary captain working for [[Elayne Trakand]].

== Appearance ==
He was short and slender, with the front of his head shaved.

== Activities ==
He works for Elayne, pushing back the sorties from [[Arymilla Marne]].
He demands Elayne for more money due to a loss of men. She sends him away with no agreement.
Later, he, [[Rhys a'Balaman]] and [[Evard Cordwyn]] turn coat and attack the [[Far Madding Gate]]. Elayne later signs his death warrant.
